example.description: Subtract the tracked Launch annual price from the tracked Grow annual price.
example.excerpt: Front Step Sites lists Launch at $99 yearly and Grow at $290 yearly, so the difference between those two annual subscription prices is `$290 - $99 = $191`.

references.sourceExcerpt: The Wix SEO Setup Checklist is a step-by-step checklist designed to help you improve your site's search engine optimization (SEO) based on your business's information and your keywords.
references.supportingClaim: [The Wix Help Center](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-seo-setup-checklist-creating-your-seo-checklist) says, “The Wix SEO Setup Checklist is a step-by-step checklist designed to help you improve your site's search engine optimization (SEO).”
references.primarySourceRationale: Wix maintains the official product documentation for its own SEO Setup Checklist.

references.sourceExcerpt: Google uses the mobile version of a site's content, crawled with the smartphone agent, for indexing and ranking. This is called mobile-first indexing.
references.supportingClaim: [Google Search Central](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/mobile/mobile-sites-mobile-first-indexing) says, “Google uses the mobile version of a site's content, crawled with the smartphone agent, for indexing and ranking.”
references.primarySourceRationale: Google Search Central is Google's official documentation for its indexing systems.

claimRationale: The Wix reference and its supporting claim now appear together in the post, followed by an explicit limit: the source describes the checklist's SEO purpose but does not guarantee indexing or rankings. The Google reference and quoted mobile-first indexing claim also appear together in the post. The tracked plan table supports only the $191 subtraction between two Front Step Sites annual prices; the post expressly limits that evidence and does not use it as a Wix price or performance claim.
